GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Vet exam prior to race and was passed fit to start. Had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the straight. Altered course near the 150m to continue into clear running. Rdr said he had been inst to be midfield, however mount which was back in distance began only fairly and then did not muster speed and as a result settled towards the rear. Added mount did not travel well with strong tempo however once clear ran on strongly.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin, then shortly after was steadied when awkwardly placed close to heels. Rider reported after commencing awkwardly the mare failed to travel and he was of the opinion that it may be better suited on tracks with more give. Trainer reported that the mare appeared agitated pre-race and this may have been detrimental to its performance. Added that the mare had worked well in the lead-up to today's event and the stable had expected a forward showing. Further added that the mare would be given a brief freshen-up prior to its next start.  Post-race vet exam - no abnormalities.
